newsitem.title: USA: N.J. estimates $700 mln excess revenues for FY '97.
newsitem.headline: N.J. estimates $700 mln excess revenues for FY '97.

text.p: New Jersey's Office of Legislative Services said Wednesday the state would end fiscal 1997 with $700 million more in revenue collections than originally forecast.
State Treasurer Brian Clymer said Tuesday that revenue collections of $13.2 billion through April 30 were about $167 million above projections. The fiscal year ends on June 30.

Gov. Christine Whitman said she would hold a press Wednesday to further detail the new figures and address how she would respond to a state Supreme Court ruling Wednesday calling for more state aid to poor school districts.
